name: Nashiro Touma
source:
Hana's Classmate.

Touma is a good student, and comes from a rich family.

He appears to have similar interests as Hana as he is on the same library committee.

Overall, he gives off an innocent, friendly vibe.

And he often offers to help Hana with schoolwork and other things like that.

[From [url=http://twinproject.weebly.com/chocolate-cage.html]Twin Project[/url]]
